notes: v4.9.5: Back closes one layer per press (sheet → pin card → full map). New ? help button with an optional 11-step tour; a one-time welcome card you can ignore. Bank spot in Markets: pick your bank, type a balance if you like (saved only on this phone, never a login), tap to open the bank. Ticker now glides like a market board, with gold and more coins. Map location dot is crisp, with a small direction cone only when your phone gives a real compass. Gentle hologram motion you can switch off in Settings (Motion). Faster load: smaller app file and fonts (about 80% less to download). Maps keep working offline for places you've seen, switch to a backup tile server if the main one is down, and search remembers answers. One Add button per card, Phone card title, Android home-screen icons and iPhone launch screens. The iPhone Scriptable widget is no longer offered.
